title: HR200-BTTG-N601
brief: The HR200-BTTG-N601 is a state-of-the-art 60W PoE injector, designed to meet the demanding needs of modern network infrastructure. This powerful device seamlessly integrates power and data supply over a single cable, providing an efficient and reliable solution for powering devices such as IP cameras, Wi-Fi access points, and VoIP phones in high-performance environments. With its robust build and versatile compatibility, the HR200-BTTG-N601 is the ideal choice for both enterprise and home applications.
parameter:
Features and Highlights

• Support 1* 10G PoE power supply port+1* 10G RJ45 port
• Compatible with IEEE802.3af (15.4W), IEEE802.3at (30W), and IEEE802.3bt (60W)
• Supports AC 100-240V power supply
• Metal casing, IP20 protection level, operating temperature range of -20 to 50 °C

title: HR-AFR-21+
brief: The HRUI 2-Port PoE Extender utilizes cutting-edge network cable technology and power supply innovations to extend the standard Ethernet transmission distance beyond 100 meters, reaching up to 250 meters. Compatible with PoE switches and PoE injectors that adhere to the IEEE802.3af/at standards, this product is ideal for applications in security PoE network monitoring and PoE network installations. Featuring high-quality, high-speed network ICs and the most reliable PoE chips, it guarantees the safe and stable operation of your network.
other: APPLICATION
parameter:
Highlight

• 1* 100Mbps PoE in RJ45 port+2 *100Mbps PoE out ports
• Complies with IEEE 802.3, IEEE 802.3u, and IEEE 802.3x standards
• Support IEEE802.3af/at power supply standard
• RJ45 port supports 10/100Mbps adaptive and PoE functionality
• The panel indicator lights will monitor the working status and assist in fault analysis
• Supports automatic port flipping (Auto MDI/MDIX)
• One click intelligent activation of long-distance mode
• Having network and PoE relay extension roles
• Flow control method, full duplex adopts IEEE 802.3x standard, and half duplex adopts Back pressure standard

title: HR-PE08-SV+ & HR-PE08-IPC+
brief: The HR-PE08-SV+ and HR-PE08-IPC+ are advanced 100Mbps Ethernet PoE extenders designed to enhance your network connectivity and power solutions. These extenders allow for seamless data transmission and power delivery over long distances, making them ideal for expanding your network infrastructure, especially in remote locations where power outlets may be limited. With robust connectivity features and compliance with industry standards, these extenders offer a reliable solution for both home and industrial applications.
